chunks: Neither your blood relations nor your children will be of any avail to you on the Day of Resurrection. He will judge between you, for God sees what you do.
ai.seo_question: Will family members help each other on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of individual accountability (mas'uliyya), clarifying that while kinship holds spiritual value in this life, it offers no automatic intercession (shafa'ah) on the Day of Judgment without personal merit. It serves as a reminder that divine justice separates individuals based on their own deeds, rendering familial status secondary to one's spiritual state before Allah, who is All-Seeing of every action.
